traceOfFreshEvent.conclusion: No divergence between the in-memory event and the persisted row. The persistence layer is faithful; there is no serialization or mapping defect.

secondaryDefect.title: FAILED is not terminal — the outbox processor re-claims permanently-failed rows forever
secondaryDefect.phase: Phase 0 (predates the ETA namespace issue; affects ANY permanently-failing event)
secondaryDefect.status: IDENTIFIED, NOT FIXED — remediation proposed, not executed

evidence.derivedRate: 36 attempts / 6 rows / 30s = 1 claim per row per 5s, exactly EVENTS_OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS

mechanism: outbox-processor.ts:claimBatch selects WHERE status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND available_at <= NOW()
outbox-processor.ts:markFailed, on the attempts >= maxAttempts branch, sets status='FAILED' but does NOT advance available_at
available_at therefore stays frozen at its original value (e.g. 2026-08-07T06:59:15Z), which is permanently <= NOW()
so the row satisfies the claim predicate on EVERY tick and is re-claimed forever, incrementing attempts each time
consequences: Unbounded error-log spam (this is the log noise reported as a post-fix failure)
Unbounded DB write amplification: 6 rows x 12 claims/min, indefinitely
A genuinely poisoned event never comes to rest, so no true dead-letter state is ever reached
secondaryDefect.proposedRemediationNotApplied: Make the terminal branch actually terminal — either exclude FAILED from the claim predicate, or move terminally-failed rows to the DLQ status. This TIGHTENS the contract; it does not weaken validation, does not touch the namespace check, and does not hide the failure. Requires explicit approval before implementation.
explicitlyNotDone: retry behaviour was NOT altered to suppress the symptom
no outbox rows were deleted, truncated, or migrated
